reason: A proposes a broadly physically plausible and directly testable comparison linking local Al/Cr/Si availability to protective-scale continuity, although processing confounds and the prediction of a thicker protective scale need refinement. B incorrectly transfers precise results from a Y/Hf-co-doped alloy comparison to severe deformation of an identical composition, while its claim that an ultrafine grain-boundary-rich structure will suppress Al transport—and remain stable for 500 h at 1200 °C—is poorly supported and mechanistically questionable.
